items.quote: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him
items.claim: Noah and his family departed from the ark
items.actor: Noah, his sons, his wife, his sons' wives

items.quote: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
items.claim: All animals of various types departed from the ark organized by kind
items.actor: Every beast, every creeping thing, every fowl, whatsoever creepeth upon the earth
